en: In the sky, we wish to be birds flying wing to wing; on the earth, we wish to be trees with intertwining branches.

t: 天長地久有時盡，此恨綿綿無絕期。
c: 天长地久有时尽，此恨绵绵无绝期。
p: Tiān cháng dì jiǔ yǒu shí jìn, cǐ hèn mián mián wú jué qī.
z: ㄊㄧㄢ ㄔㄤˊ ㄉㄧˋ ㄐㄧㄡˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ， ㄘˇ ㄏㄣˋ ㄇㄧㄢˊ ㄇㄧㄢˊ ㄨˊ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄑㄧ 。
en: Heaven is long and earth is old, but they have an end; this regret is continuous, with no time of ceasing.
